title: Recycling & Waste: Beyond the Bin
welcome_lead: Big systems shape what we throw away — and what we don't.
meta_desc: KS3 environmental science: circular economy, packaging, choices.
final_note: Buy less, think more — your bin will thank you.

concepts.def: System designed to reuse materials forever.

walkthroughs.body_html: A circular economy designs products to be repaired, reused and recycled. The old 'take-make-dump' line is replaced with a loop.
Around 8 million tonnes of plastic enter the sea every year. It breaks into microplastics that fish eat — and people eat fish.
Carry a reusable bottle. Refuse single-use plastic where you can. Compost food scraps. Repair before replacing.
